question_en: What do you usually do on weekends?

options.A: 我周末不吃饭。(I don't eat on weekends.)
options.B: 我周末去公司上班。(I go to work at the company on weekends.)
options.C: 我周末起得很早。(I get up very early on weekends.)
options.D: 我周末一般在家看书。(I usually read books at home on weekends.)

explanation: '一般做什么'询问日常习惯，A回答日常活动。B是工作（周末通常不上班），C是时间描述，D不符合常理。

question_en: Why didn't you answer the phone?

options.A: 我在打电话。(I was on the phone.)
options.B: 我不喜欢电话。(I don't like phones.)
options.C: 电话坏了。(The phone is broken.)
options.D: 我没听见。(I didn't hear it.)

explanation: '怎么不'询问原因，A解释没听见（合理原因）。B是偏好，C是设备问题（可能但不如A常见），D逻辑矛盾（在打电话应该能接）。

question_en: How is this piece of clothing?

options.A: 这件衣服是红色的。(This clothing is red.)
options.B: 这件衣服太贵了。(This clothing is too expensive.)
options.C: 这件衣服很大。(This clothing is very big.)
options.D: 这件衣服是棉的。(This clothing is made of cotton.)

explanation: '怎么样'询问综合评价，A是评价（太贵）。B、C、D都是客观描述，不是综合感受。

question_en: Have you been well recently?

options.A: 最近有点感冒。(I've had a slight cold recently.)
options.B: 我最近很忙。(I've been very busy recently.)
options.C: 我最近在学习。(I've been studying recently.)
options.D: 我最近在旅行。(I've been traveling recently.)

explanation: '身体好吗'询问健康状况，A回答健康状态（感冒）。B、C、D都是活动/状态，不涉及身体。

question_cn: 你觉得这部电影怎么样？
question_en: What do you think of this movie?

options.A: 电影很长。(The movie is very long.)
options.B: 我觉得很好看。(I think it's very good.)
options.C: 电影是美国的。(The movie is American.)
options.D: 我昨天看的。(I watched it yesterday.)

explanation: '觉得……怎么样'询问主观评价，A是主观感受。B、C是客观描述，D回答时间，均不匹配。

question_cn: 你打算假期去哪儿旅行？
question_en: Where do you plan to travel during the holiday?

options.B: 我假期有很多作业。(I have a lot of homework during the holiday.)
options.C: 我打算去云南。(I plan to go to Yunnan.)
options.D: 假期有七天。(The holiday is seven days long.)

explanation: '打算去哪儿'询问计划目的地，A回答地点。B说作业，C说喜好，D说时长，均不匹配。

question_en: Can you help me?

options.A: 当然可以，什么事？(Of course, what is it?)
options.D: 你要做什么？(What do you want to do?)

explanation: '能帮我吗'请求帮助，A是积极回应。B答非所问，C是拒绝（但不够礼貌），D反问未表态。

question_en: Are you used to the life here?

options.A: 慢慢习惯了。(Slowly getting used to it.)
options.B: 这里的生活很好。(The life here is very good.)
options.C: 我喜欢这里。(I like it here.)
options.D: 我在这里工作。(I work here.)

explanation: '习惯……吗'询问适应情况，A直接回答适应程度。B评价生活，C表达喜好，D说工作，均不匹配。

question_en: Why do you study Chinese?

options.A: 汉语很难。(Chinese is very difficult.)
options.B: 因为我对中国文化很感兴趣。(Because I am very interested in Chinese culture.)
options.C: 我在中国工作。(I work in China.)
options.D: 我学了三年。(I have studied for three years.)

explanation: '为什么'询问原因，A用'因为'回答原因。B是评价，C是背景，D是时长，均不匹配。

question_cn: 你更喜欢冬天还是夏天？
question_en: Do you prefer winter or summer?

options.A: 我更喜欢夏天。(I prefer summer.)
options.B: 夏天很热。(Summer is very hot.)
options.C: 冬天可以滑雪。(You can ski in winter.)
options.D: 两个季节都好。(Both seasons are good.)

explanation: 'A还是B'选择疑问句，A明确选择。B、C是描述，D未明确选择，均不符合要求。

question_en: What happened to your phone?

options.A: 手机很新。(The phone is very new.)
options.B: 手机是黑色的。(The phone is black.)
options.C: 屏幕摔坏了。(The screen is broken from a fall.)
options.D: 我买了手机。(I bought a phone.)

explanation: '怎么了'询问问题/故障，A回答故障（屏幕坏了）。B说颜色，C说新旧，D说购买，均不匹配。

question_en: Are you free tomorrow?

options.A: 明天下午有空。(I am free tomorrow afternoon.)
options.B: 明天是星期三。(Tomorrow is Wednesday.)
options.C: 明天我要上班。(I have to work tomorrow.)
options.D: 明天天气很好。(The weather is nice tomorrow.)

explanation: '有空吗'询问是否有时间，A直接回答有空。B回答日期，C说上班（暗示没空但不够直接），D说天气，均不匹配。

question_en: I ______ been to Beijing.
explanation: '已经……过'表示经历完成，'我已经去过'=I have already been to。'正在'表现在进行，'常常'表频率，'一起'表伴随，均不与'过'搭配。

question_en: He ______ studying in the library.
explanation: '正在+动词'表现在进行时。'已经'表完成，'一起'表伴随，'非常'是程度副词，均不表现在进行。

question_en: This room is ______ than that room.
explanation: '比'是比较句标志，后面用形容词原形。'很大'无比较，'最大'是最高级，'不大'是否定，均不与'比'搭配。

question_en: I am tall ______ him.
explanation: 'A比B+形容词'是比较句结构。'和'表并列，'对'表对象，'从'表起点，均不表比较。

question_en: ______ the weather is too hot, let's ______ go swimming.
explanation: 前句是原因（天气热），后句是结果（去游泳），用'因为……所以……'。B表转折，C表假设，D表递进，均不匹配。

question_en: I ______ can cook.
explanation: '还'表示附加能力，'我还会做饭'=I can also cook。'很'、'太'、'多'均不修饰'会'表附加。

question_en: Could you ______ close the window?
explanation: 请求他人做某事用'可以……吗'最礼貌自然。'会'表能力，'能'表可能性，'要'表意愿，均不如A适合请求。

question_en: He exercises ______ every day.
explanation: '坚持'强调持续做某事（常接动词），'坚持运动'=persist in exercising。'继续'表接着做，'保持'常接状态，'保留'表留存，均不匹配。

question_en: ______ you work hard, ______ you can succeed.
explanation: 前句是条件（努力），后句是结果（成功），用'只要……就……'表条件关系。B表因果，C表转折，D表递进，均不匹配。

question_en: I ______ saw him.
explanation: '刚才'表示刚刚发生，与过去时搭配。'现在'表现在，'常常'表频率，'一起'表伴随，均不与过去时搭配。

question_en: This piece of clothing, ______ I wear it, is too big.
explanation: '对……来说'表示'对于某人'，'对我来说'=for me。'给'表给予，'向'表方向，'从'表起点，均不匹配。

question_en: He speaks Chinese ______ very well.
explanation: '得'用于动词和补语之间，'说得很好'中'很好'是'说'的补语。'的'表修饰，'地'表状语，'了'表完成，均不匹配。

question_en: What is the opposite of '方便' (fāngbiàn / convenient)?
explanation: A表示做事麻烦、不方便，是'方便'的反义。B表示事情容易做。C表示事情简单不复杂。D表示速度快。

question_en: What does '打扫' (dǎsǎo) mean?
explanation: A表示清理、扫除灰尘和垃圾。B表示烹饪食物。C表示用水清洗。D表示修理损坏的东西。

question_en: What kind of person does '热情' (rèqíng) describe?
explanation: A形容人对事物充满热情和积极性。B形容人害羞、不敢表达自己。C形容人安静、不爱说话。D形容人懒惰、不爱劳动。

question_en: What does '请假' (qǐngjià) mean?
explanation: A表示向上级或老师请求暂时离开。B表示去外地度假休息。C表示停止工作休息。D表示辞去工作不再做。

question_en: What is the relationship between '提高' (tígāo) and '降低' (jiàngdī)?
explanation: A表示方向相反，'提高'是向上，'降低'是向下。B表示意思相近。C表示意思有点接近。D表示没有关联。

question_en: What does '担心' (dānxīn) mean?
explanation: A表示心里不安、不放心。B表示对未来的美好期望。C表示对某人或某事有信心。D表示不记得某事。

question_en: What does '习惯' (xíguàn) mean as a verb?
explanation: A表示逐渐适应并养成某种行为方式。B表示对某事物有好感。C表示必须拥有某物。D表示试着做某事。

question_en: What does '准备' (zhǔnbèi) mean?
explanation: A表示事先安排好或做好某事。B表示事情已经完成。C表示事情开始进行。D表示事情停止不做。

passage_cn: 小明每天早上七点起床，然后吃早饭。他喜欢喝牛奶，吃面包。吃完早饭，他去学校上课。
passage_en: Xiaoming gets up at 7 every morning, then eats breakfast. He likes to drink milk and eat bread. After breakfast, he goes to school for class.
question_en: What does Xiaoming like to drink in the morning?
explanation: 文中明确说'他喜欢喝牛奶'。B、C、D文中均未提及。

passage_cn: 李小姐在一家医院工作。她每天很忙，但是很喜欢自己的工作。她觉得帮助病人是一件很有意义的事情。
passage_en: Miss Li works at a hospital. She is very busy every day, but she likes her job very much. She thinks helping patients is very meaningful.
question_en: Where does Miss Li work?
explanation: 文中第一句'在一家医院工作'明确说明。B、C、D均与原文不符。

passage_cn: 昨天是我的生日，朋友们来我家玩。妈妈做了很多好吃的菜。我们唱歌、跳舞，玩得很开心。
passage_en: Yesterday was my birthday. Friends came to my home to play. Mom cooked a lot of delicious food. We sang, danced, and had a great time.
question_en: What day was yesterday?
explanation: 文中第一句'昨天是我的生日'。B、C、D文中均未提及。

question_en: Nǐ píngshí zěnme duànliàn shēntǐ? (How do you usually exercise?)

options.A: 我周末不上班。(I don't work on weekends.)
options.B: 我喜欢吃水果。(I like eating fruit.)
options.C: 我家离公司很近。(My home is close to the company.)
options.D: 我每天早上跑步。(I go running every morning.)

explanation: '怎么锻炼身体'询问运动方式，A回答跑步。B说饮食，C说距离，D说工作，均不匹配。 / 'How do you exercise' asks about exercise methods; A answers running. B is about diet, C about distance, D about work.

question_cn: 你最喜欢的季节是哪个？
question_en: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié shì nǎge? (Which season do you like best?)

options.A: 春天有很多花。(There are many flowers in spring.)
options.B: 我最喜欢春天，天气很舒服。(I like spring best; the weather is very comfortable.)
options.C: 春天在三月份。(Spring is in March.)
options.D: 春天比冬天暖和。(Spring is warmer than winter.)

explanation: '最喜欢哪个'要求明确选择并说明原因，A直接选择并给出理由。B、C、D都是描述，未明确回答'最喜欢'。 / 'Which do you like best' requires a clear choice with reasons; A directly chooses and gives a reason. B, C, D are descriptions without a clear choice.

question_en: Nǐ de diànnǎo zěnme le? (What happened to your computer?)

options.A: 开不了机了，可能是电池坏了。(It won't turn on; maybe the battery is broken.)
options.B: 我的电脑是黑色的。(My computer is black.)
options.C: 我刚买了这台电脑。(I just bought this computer.)
options.D: 电脑放在桌子上。(The computer is on the table.)

explanation: '怎么了'询问故障，A回答具体问题（开不了机）。B说颜色，C说购买，D说位置，均不匹配。 / 'What happened' asks about a problem; A answers with a specific issue. B is color, C is purchase, D is location.

question_en: Nǐ juéde xué kāichē nán ma? (Do you think learning to drive is difficult?)

options.A: 刚开始有点难，现在熟练了。(It was a bit hard at first, but now I'm skilled.)
options.B: 开车需要考驾照。(Driving requires a license.)
options.D: 开车比骑自行车快。(Driving is faster than cycling.)

explanation: '难吗'询问难度感受，A直接回答难度变化。B说要求，C说喜好，D说比较，均不匹配。 / 'Is it difficult' asks about difficulty; A directly answers about the change in difficulty. B is about requirements, C about preference, D about comparison.

question_en: Nǐ píngshí jǐ diǎn shuìjiào? (What time do you usually go to bed?)

options.A: 我一般十一点左右睡觉。(I usually go to bed around eleven.)
options.B: 我睡眠质量很好。(My sleep quality is very good.)
options.C: 我晚上不喝咖啡。(I don't drink coffee at night.)
options.D: 我早上七点起床。(I get up at seven in the morning.)

explanation: '几点睡觉'询问时间，A回答具体时间。B说质量，C说饮食，D说起床时间，均不匹配。 / 'What time do you go to bed' asks for time; A answers with a specific time. B is about quality, C about diet, D about wake-up time.

question_en: Wǒ ______ xiǎng hē yì bēi kāfēi. (I ______ want to drink a cup of coffee.)
explanation: '现在'表示此刻，'现在想喝'=want to drink right now。'已经'表完成，'常常'表频率，'一起'表伴随，均不匹配。 / 'Now' indicates the present moment. 'Already' indicates completion, 'often' indicates frequency, 'together' indicates accompaniment.

question_en: Tā ______ Hànyǔ, ______ Yīngyǔ. (He ______ Chinese, ______ English.)
explanation: '不但……而且……'表递进，'不但会汉语而且会英语'=not only speaks Chinese but also English。B表转折，C表因果，D表假设，均不匹配。 / 'Not only...but also' indicates progression. B indicates contrast, C indicates cause-effect, D indicates hypothesis.

question_en: ______ xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bù qù le. (______ it rains, we won't go.)
explanation: '如果……就……'表假设，'如果下雨就不去'=if it rains, we won't go。'因为'表因果，'虽然'表转折，'不但'表递进，均不匹配。 / 'If...then' indicates hypothesis. 'Because' indicates cause-effect, 'although' indicates contrast, 'not only' indicates progression.

question_en: Zhège fángjiān ______ gānjìng ______ míngliàng. (This room is ______ clean ______ bright.)
explanation: '又……又……'表并列，'又干净又明亮'=both clean and bright。B表转折，C表因果，D表假设，均不匹配。 / 'Both...and' indicates parallelism. B indicates contrast, C indicates cause-effect, D indicates hypothesis.

question_en: Nǐ ______ qùguò Chángchéng ma? (Have you ______ been to the Great Wall?)
explanation: '曾经……过'表示过去的经历，'曾经去过'=have ever been to。'正在'表现在进行，'常常'表现在习惯，'一起'表伴随，均不匹配。 / 'Ever...before' indicates past experience. 'Currently' indicates present continuous, 'often' indicates present habit, 'together' indicates accompaniment.

question_en: 'Ānjìng' shì shénme yìsi? (What does 'ānjìng' mean?)
explanation: A表示没有声音、不吵闹。B表示声音大、吵闹（反义词）。C表示开心。D表示难过。 / A means without sound, not noisy. B means loud, noisy (antonym). C means happy. D means sad.

question_en: 'Wàngjì' de fǎnyìcí shì shénme? (What is the opposite of 'wàngjì' / forget?)
explanation: A表示记得、没有忘掉，是'忘记'的反义词。B表示丢失。C表示找到。D表示离开。 / A means to remember, not forget (antonym). B means to lose. C means to find. D means to leave.

question_en: 'Chāoshì' shì shénme dìfang? (What kind of place is 'chāoshì'?)
explanation: A表示售卖各种商品的大型商店。B表示看病的地方。C表示学习的地方。D表示休闲娱乐的地方。 / A is a large store selling various goods. B is for medical treatment. C is for studying. D is for recreation.

passage_cn: 小李每天早上六点起床，先跑步半小时，然后回家洗澡、吃早饭。八点他去公司上班。他说，早起运动让他一天都很有精神。
passage_en: Xiǎo Lǐ gets up at six every morning, runs for half an hour first, then goes home to shower and eat breakfast. At eight he goes to work. He says that exercising early makes him energetic all day.
question_en: Xiǎo Lǐ zǎoshang xiān zuò shénme? (What does Xiao Li do first in the morning?)
explanation: 文中说'先跑步半小时'，所以跑步是第一件事。B、C、D都是跑步之后做的事。 / The text says 'runs for half an hour first,' so running is the first thing. B, C, D are done after running.

passage_cn: 王老师的家离学校很远，她每天坐地铁上班，需要一个小时。虽然路上时间很长，但是她觉得地铁比公交车快，也比开车省钱。
passage_en: Teacher Wang's home is far from school. She takes the subway to work every day, which takes an hour. Although the commute is long, she thinks the subway is faster than the bus and cheaper than driving.
question_cn: 王老师为什么坐地铁上班？
question_en: Wáng lǎoshī wèishénme zuò dìtiě shàngbān? (Why does Teacher Wang take the subway to work?)

options.B: 因为她家离地铁站很近
options.C: 因为地铁比公交车快，也比开车省钱

explanation: 文中明确说'她觉得地铁比公交车快，也比开车省钱'。B、C、D文中均未提及。 / The text explicitly states she thinks the subway is faster than the bus and cheaper than driving. B, C, D are not mentioned.
